name: knowledge_manage
description: Manage knowledge bases: create, list, delete, list files, and P2 external converters (paddleocr/anydoc): list converters, install/detect, convert files to Markdown.
author: TianShu

action.description: Action to perform: create a base, list bases, delete a base, list files, list external converters, install/detect a converter, or convert a file

path.description: Absolute root directory path (required for create)

kb_id.description: Knowledge base ID (for delete / list_files / convert)

converter.description: Converter ID (for install_converter / convert): paddleocr or anydoc

file.description: File to convert (for convert): name in originals/, absolute path, or relative to the KB root
